name: my-yoink-bridge
description: My yoink bridge on Cloudflare Workers, built on the yoink-bridge SDK. Edit bridge.ts.

KEY_FROM_YOINK_APP.description: **Paste the key from your yoink app here — don't make one up.** On your iPhone, in yoink: **Einstellungen › Ausgänge › Bridge einrichten › Schlüssel kopieren**, then paste it into this field. It starts with `whsec_`. Only yoink has this key, so only yoink can send to your bridge; the bridge never shows it. __Deutsch:__ Den Schlüssel aus der yoink-App hier einfügen (Einstellungen › Ausgänge › Bridge einrichten › Schlüssel kopieren). Er beginnt mit `whsec_`.

BRIDGE_KV.description: Remembers recent delivery ids for 48 hours, so an entry yoink sends again after a timeout is not handled twice. The default name is fine.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional, add later as a secret (Worker › Settings › Variables and Secrets). Turns on the `github` destination together with `GITHUB_REPO`. GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → [Fine-grained tokens](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new): only your repository, permission **Issues: Read and write**.

GITHUB_REPO.description: Optional, add later. The repository for new issues, `owner/name` (e.g. `octocat/hello-world`).

LINEAR_API_KEY.description: Optional, add later as a secret (Worker › Settings › Variables and Secrets). Turns on the `linear` destination together with `LINEAR_TEAM`. Linear → **Settings → Security & access → Personal API keys** → New key.

LINEAR_TEAM.description: Optional, add later. The Linear **team key**, the prefix of its issue ids (e.g. `ABC` for `ABC-12`).
